_why: Two human playthroughs said blockers are close to inert: three bombs on gen-0017 were swept off the board by move 2 without being aimed at, and two ice tiles on a 30-cell board did not register as an obstacle. Blocker count was the wrong difficulty knob. What actually forces short early chains - the setup phase the player enjoyed on gen-0010 - is the minimum chain length relative to how dense the board is. This space holds blockers at zero and varies that instead.
_risk: minChain 5 is the known lockout factory (the rejected level-53 candidate, gen-0000, gen-0021). It is back in range here deliberately, because the question is whether there is a board size where it constrains without killing boards. The zero-lockout gate is the thing standing between that question and a shipped dead board.
